privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.p1: We collect information you provide when creating an account, including your name and email from Google sign-in or email sign-in, plus usage data such as generated content, saved items, and interaction patterns. If you use an admin-issued demo code, we process that code to authenticate your demo account.
privacyPage.p2: Your information is used to provide and improve our services, generate AI responses, maintain your saved content, and communicate service updates.
privacyPage.p3: Your inputs are sent to OpenRouter for AI processing using the model you select. We do not use your content to train AI models.
privacyPage.p4: Your data is stored securely using Supabase infrastructure with encryption at rest and in transit.
privacyPage.p5: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with OpenRouter for AI processing and payment processors for billing.
privacyPage.p6: You may access, export, or delete your data at any time from your account settings. Account deletion removes all associated data.
privacyPage.p7: We use essential cookies and browser storage for authentication and preferences. We use PostHog for product analytics and Sentry for error monitoring, structured logs, application metrics, performance tracing, and error-only Session Replay. Sentry does not record ordinary sessions. It records sessions containing captured errors; all replay text and inputs are masked and media is blocked. Sentry receives technical metadata such as routes, browser details, request URLs, methods and status codes, stack traces, timings, and safe event classifications. Automatic collection of user identity, cookies, headers, HTTP bodies, query parameters, AI inputs and outputs, and stack-frame variables is disabled. PostHog autocapture, pageview capture, session recording, and persistent browser storage are disabled. We do not send debate content, chat messages, source titles, or email addresses in analytics events or structured logs.
privacyPage.p8: DebateLab is designed for users 13 and older. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13.
privacyPage.p9: We may update this policy periodically. Significant changes will be communicated via email or in-app notification.
privacyPage.p10: For privacy questions or data requests, contact us at privacy@debatelab.app.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.p1: By using DebateLab, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
termsPage.p2: DebateLab is an AI-powered debate preparation tool that provides argument generation, analysis, and coaching features.
termsPage.p3: You may sign in with Google, email-based sign-in, or an admin-issued demo code. Demo codes provide temporary access to a designated account. You are responsible for all activity under your account.
termsPage.p4: Free trials last 3 days with limited requests. Pro subscriptions are $5/month plus tax, billed via Stripe. Cancel anytime from Settings.
termsPage.p5: You may not use DebateLab for harassment, generating harmful content, academic dishonesty in violation of your institution's policies, or any illegal purpose.
termsPage.p6: AI outputs are provided as-is without guarantees of accuracy. You are responsible for verifying facts and citations before use in competitions.
termsPage.p7: You retain ownership of your inputs. AI-generated outputs are licensed to you for personal and educational use. DebateLab retains rights to the platform and its technology.
termsPage.p8: DebateLab is provided as-is. We are not liable for competition outcomes, inaccurate AI outputs, or service interruptions.
termsPage.p9: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may delete your account at any time.
termsPage.p10: These terms are governed by applicable law. Disputes will be resolved through binding arbitration.

roleGuidance.introductor: Open with an exordio, define the key terms, set the framework and thesis, then give the roadmap. Save the full arguments for R1.
roleGuidance.r1: Build the core arguments with claims, warrants, support, and impacts. Use the final part to anticipate or answer the strongest opposition.
roleGuidance.r2: Extend R1, answer the opponent directly, identify the central clashes, and compare the impacts. Do not simply repeat the case.
roleGuidance.conclusor: Add no new arguments. Crystallize the decisive clashes, weigh the round, and close with the reason your side wins.
